dataLineage.statement:
Layer was downloaded as a shapefile by ITOS from HDX. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file geodatabase.
The following was found and fixed by ITOS: 1. Created and populated reference name field 2. Admin1 p-codes were changed from numeric to alphanumeric by appending the ISO code 3. Created and populated Admin1 Mongolian name field. Values come from the Admin2 layer 4. Layer now uses name "монгол" in Admin0 Mongolian name field
